equip_instructions: Pick a story unit by id (that-boy-hi-hat-bio, zooted-zone-story, diabolique-release, new-rap-hits-momentum) — or pull the single unit file straight from https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/copy-desk/units/
Quote only the claims as written: each claim ships with its source and observed_date — cite them like a wire service.
Never add uncited claims: the truth gate (deny-list + verified-facts registry) rejects anything without a source and observed date.
Brand rule: the CWI logo badge ships on every visual asset that carries the units.

item.description: The Press department's truth-gated, machine-readable story units — product #15 of the Agent Deck gear line. Pre-verified, source-cited building blocks (artist bios, track stories, release announcements, momentum notes) an agent PULLS and QUOTES instead of writing PR from scratch or hallucinating facts. Every claim carries its source and observation date; the truth gate rejects anything uncited. Equips as a utility: the fact-source agents that write about artists pull from weekly.
item.name: COPY DESK

truth_gate.rule: Every claim must carry a source and an observed_date. Uncited claims are rejected.
